review_scope: Bounded historical same-trial secondary functioning report
title: Effect of behavior therapy for Tourette's disorder on psychiatric symptoms and functioning in adults
novelty: Historical same-trial secondary report newly audited; not a new 2026 result or independent replication.
design: Secondary exploratory analysis of acute randomized CBIT versus psychoeducation/supportive therapy, postrandomization responder comparisons, and selected CBIT responder/completer follow-up.
population: 122 older adolescents and adults aged 16–69 (mean 31.6), Tourette disorder/chronic motor/chronic vocal tic disorders; clinical stability and other eligibility restrictions. No adult-only or severe-persistent-adult functional estimate verified.

n.outcome_specific_n: Generally unreported. Table 3 parental role has one complete participant and no test; individual values excluded.

comparator: Psychoeducation and supportive therapy, an active attention/support intervention
intervention: Eight CBIT sessions over ten weeks; acute responders offered/planned three monthly boosters, individual attendance unverified.
prespecified_outcomes: Original trial primary acute tic severity. This report describes exploratory ancillary psychiatric and functional outcomes; no prespecified confirmatory functional hierarchy verified.
outcome: SDS disability; FAM-III family functioning; SAS-SR adjustment domains, separately from tic and psychiatric measures. Lower functional scores indicate less disability/maladjustment; SDS total scoring version not fully reconciled.

selected_followup_omnibus.baseline_month6_significance: Not documented by table marker; broader prose should not substitute.

numeric_result.restricted_posthoc_multiplicity: No functional test remains below .05 under separate Holm/Bonferroni families of 12, 12 and 11; these families do not adjust the full study or restore confirmation.

followup: Six months after acute treatment; only acute responders invited, CBIT returnees analyzed; no preserved randomized between-arm comparison.
attrition: 122 randomized, 113 acute analyzed and 105 acute completers differ; outcome-specific denominator/df missing. CBIT follow-up 15 selected returnees; no nonresponder follow-up. Nonsignificant baseline differences do not prove random missingness.
adverse_events: No new systematic adverse-event comparison established by this secondary functioning analysis; psychiatric nonsignificance is not proof of no harm.
risk_of_bias: Exploratory multiplicity, unmasked self-report, missing outcome-specific counts and confidence intervals, postrandomization response conditioning, selected follow-up, no long-term randomized comparator, clinical-stability selection. Figure screening arithmetic and PST follow-up counts conflict.
conflicts_funding: NIMH and TAA/AAN/ABF support. Authors state no work-associated conflicts; detailed consultancy, honoraria and royalties disclosed.
applicability: Mixed older-adolescent/adult clinic sample, not adult-only, representative population or severe-persistent-adult stratum. No pain-specific or GTS-QOL endpoint.
cohort_overlap_status: Same trial as Wilhelm 2012; not independent replication.
claim_supported: No demonstrated acute randomized superiority on the 12 reported functional contrasts. Limited exploratory responder associations and selected within-CBIT follow-up disability changes require distinct interpretation.
claim_not_supported: Equivalence; no clinically important benefit; causal tic-to-function mediation; universal functional improvement; an all-randomized six-month effect; off-treatment durability; remission, disease modification or cure.
retrieval_status: PMC author-manuscript full methods/tables inspected using ordinary HTTP; figure visually inspected; publisher abstract and metadata checked. Final-published full tables not separately inspected. No full paper or n=1 follow-up scores saved.
reviewer: Research assistant extraction plus independent source/numeric audit matching 363 numerical cells and 144 output/marker checks; 13 implementation tests passed. Not clinical peer review.
correction_retraction_check: Focused PMID/DOI correction/retraction searches found no notice; not comprehensive clearance.
next_verification_task: Close same-trial chain absent corrected material reporting. Next audit adult tic-related pain ascertainment/measurement and limits of self-reported care effectiveness in Małek 2025, PMID 40808742, DOI 10.3389/fpsyg.2025.1537088, before any new aggregate computation.
privacy: Single-participant follow-up parental-role scores and changes excluded; only n=1/untested metadata retained.
